preconditions.expression: len(p) < len(t) and len(p) >= 1 and len(t) <= 200000
preconditions.description: The length of p is strictly less than the length of t, and both lengths are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= len(t) for a_i in a) and len(a) == len(t) and len(set(a)) == len(t)
preconditions.description: The permutation a is a valid sequence of distinct indices from 1 to the length of t.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in p)
preconditions.description: Both words t and p consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout.isdigit() and int(stdout) >= 0 and int(stdout) <= len(t) - len(p)
postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the maximum number of letters Nastya can remove before Sergey stops her.

postconditions.expression: let remaining_chars = [t[a_i - 1] for a_i in a[:int(stdout)]]; let current_word = ''.join([t[i] for i in range(len(t)) if (i + 1) not in a[:int(stdout)]]); let p_chars = list(p); let remaining_p_chars = sorted(p_chars); let current_word_chars = sorted([c for c in current_word]); all(remaining_p_chars == current_word_chars)
postconditions.description: After removing the first int(stdout) letters according to permutation a, the remaining letters in t can still form the word p when sorted.

postconditions.expression: let next_removal = a[int(stdout)] if int(stdout) < len(a) else None; let next_word = ''.join([t[i] for i in range(len(t)) if (i + 1) not in a[:int(stdout) + 1]]) if next_removal else ''; let next_word_chars = sorted([c for c in next_word]); let remaining_p_chars = sorted(list(p)); not all(remaining_p_chars == next_word_chars)
postconditions.description: If Nastya removes one more letter (the next in permutation a), the remaining letters in t cannot form the word p when sorted.
